notablePrerequisites:
You control at least eight lands, five of which enter the battlefield untapped and can tap to produce at least {5}.
You have enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable.
description:
Activate five lands by tapping them, adding at least {5}.
Activate Meloku five times by paying {5} and returning the five lands from the battlefield to your hand, creating five 1/1 Illusion creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar four times by sacrificing four Illusions, adding {2}{G}{G}.
Cast Journey to the Oracle either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {2}{G}{G} and commander tax, if applicable.
Archmage Emeritus triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve Journey to the Oracle, putting at least five lands from your hand onto the battlefield, then causing you to discard a card and Journey to the Oracle to your hand.
Repeat.
